story_type: hurricane flood day, kids, elders and dogs airlifted by helicopter crews
hook: In one day after Florence, 67 people and 12 pets were rescued.
narration: Kids and their dog ran for a Coast Guard helicopter as Florence flooded North Carolina.
That one day, Coast Guard aircrews helped rescue sixty-seven people and twelve pets.
Florence had turned neighborhoods into lakes, and roads into fast brown rivers.
At one house cut off by the water, the crew lowered the rescue basket.
A woman came to the porch. We got you, a crewman told her.
She climbed in from the steps, and the helicopter lifted her up over the trees.
At another stop, the crew walked an older woman out to the aircraft, one step at a time.
Families came out with their dogs, and the crews took the dogs too.
outcome: In three days, those crews helped rescue one hundred thirty-three people and twenty pets.
title: Florence: 67 people, 12 pets in one day
description:
After Hurricane Florence flooded North Carolina, Coast Guard aircrews helped rescue 67 people and 12 pets on Sept. 16, 2018, and 133 people and 20 pets over 72 hours.
